name: Mashou
source:
"Don't tell anyone about this. It's you and teacher's secret..."
Me and my home tutor in a private room. I'm punished by him and forced to wear girls' clothes.

[from [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE061386.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
「不要告訴任何人這件事。這是你和老師的秘密……」
我和家庭教師在私人房間裡。我被他懲罰，被迫穿上女裝。

［來自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE061386.html]DLsite英文版[/url]］
